_note: Freeze record (rcca.freeze). Stages in order: dev, pre-freeze, frozen, unblinded. At stage dev nothing is frozen and every output directory must end in -dev. `python -m rcca.freeze init` draws the salt once (secrets.token_hex(16)) and moves the record to pre-freeze; `python -m rcca.freeze validate` lists what is still unfrozen; `python -m rcca.freeze seal` pins freeze_id to this record and the configs it lists. cost_weights are the w_j of C_w over tokens, tool calls and CI-equivalents (three positive numbers summing to 1; equal by default), a protocol constant fixed now and sealed. m_S, ceilings, nominal_costs, loss.tau_qual and loss.eta are filled at stage frozen from the training and tuning partitions: ceilings and nominal_costs by pasting analysis/ceilings.json and analysis/nominal_costs.json from a run fitted on the training partition (each action's nominal cost is the per-dimension median of its training records; policies select on it and are charged the realized cost after acquiring); unblinded needs all of them and signed: true. min_tasks (eligible tasks over all repositories: 180 analyzed plus 30 % for attrition) and min_tasks_per_repo (each repository) are the task-frame thresholds: `python -m corpus.build select` removes excluded_tasks before partitioning, writes corpus/<repo>/census.json and exits 3 below min_tasks_per_repo, and `python -m corpus.build census` exits 3 when the repositories together fall below min_tasks (plan Review Focus 3).

m0.auth: API key named by auth_env=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the operator's .env (never committed, never recorded by value) from 2026-10-22; the training partition was authored on the CLI's subscription login; same CLI, same model, only the billing route differs

_min_tasks_per_repo_note: 78 -> 65 on 2026-10-22, PI decision on docs/findings/2026-10-22-flask-frame-below-floor.md: flask's viable frame under the pinned interpreter is 65; the primary keeps 0.84-0.87 power at the projected 87 analyzed tasks and U_CI 0.09; the flask-only estimate is reported with its wider interval

changes: one authoring agent (m0, Claude Code); the codex mode retired before the seal
severity weights are the rubric's class anchors (CWE: its anchor; mutation: the C1 anchor), not adjudicated scores; L is class-weighted unsafe acceptance; no LLM judges, no escalations
no tuning partition: eta = 0.5 and tau_qual = 0.1 fixed from the development rehearsal (docs/findings/2026-10-21-tuning-feasibility.md), disclosed like lambda_E
one evidence repetition instead of three
_design_simplification.claim: results are for changes authored by Claude Code; the approach is model-agnostic; a second agent (Qwen2.5-72B, in-house) is a planned extension

_test_cap.rule: the test partition is reduced before the seal to the first N tasks per repository in the order of sha256(salt:task), N in proportion to each repository's test frame; the uncapped frames are kept as tasks_test_uncapped_old.jsonl; the tasks removed are never authored
_test_cap.cost: power at the single-agent admission rate falls from about 0.77 to about 0.55 for a halving of U_CI

_unblinded: 2026-10-22: the test partition is opened once, under the constants as recorded; the training partitions predict the gate is not met at them (docs/findings/2026-10-22-training-two-repos.md)

_derived_from.why: The tune partition (flask 10, click 33) was dropped before the seal and never authored. It is reopened after unblinding to author it with m0 (claude), m1 (codex, gpt-6.1-sol) and a local Qwen, for agent diversity and n. The parent record cannot list the tune configs: repos is a sealed field (rcca.freeze._UNSEALED) and fingerprint() hashes the bytes of every listed config, so adding them would make the parent report as drifted. This derived record carries the same salt, loss, ceilings, nominal_costs, oracle and producers, and differs only in the configs it lists, which differ from their parents only in out and authors.
_derived_from.status: EXPLORATORY. Every number from this record is post-unblinding and is labelled as such in the paper. It is not a confirmatory result and does not amend the parent record.
